description: List artifacts of a workflow run. Server-paged: page (default 1) and limit (default 30, maximum 50) are sent as query parameters, optional name filters by artifact name. Returns {run_id, artifacts, page, limit, count, has_next} and total_count when Forgejo sets X-Total-Count; has_next true means a further page may exist, so re-issue the call with page incremented. A missing run is an error, not an empty list. Metadata only — does not download zips.
name: list_action_run_artifacts
